parsed.title: Favorite Message Slot Unlock
parsed.oneLiner: Watch a quick game partner session to unlock favorite message saving without immediate account signup.
parsed.trigger: When guest users tap to save favorite messages on the Favorite Messages page and hit the account signup wall.
parsed.eligibility: Non-signed-up users (guests) encountering the favorite messages wall.

offer.title: Unlock Favorite Messages
offer.body: Play a 15-second game with Luzia to save your favorite messages for 72 hours.

parsed.cannibalizationGuard: Access is time-boxed to 72 hours and restricted to guests; permanent account saving and advanced personalization remain exclusive to free sign-up or Luzia+ subscription.

kpis.primary: Rewarded ad ARPDAU and ad revenue per guest DAU
kpis.holdout: 5% user-level holdout for 28 days comparing total account creation and engagement rates

risks: Users might prefer temporary ad unlocks over permanent free account creation if not clearly time-boxed.
Low fill rates in specific non-US geos.

evidence.quote: Sign up to start saving your favorite messages. It's quick, easy, and free!

newScreens.change: Add Simula rewarded offer button alongside the sign-up button on the Favorite messages sheet.

newElements.change: Simula rewarded ad invitation button for unlocking favorite messages

callouts.text: Mandatory sign-up wall blocking message saving

storyboard.caption: Today, guest users hit a strict sign-up wall when trying to save favorite messages.
We introduce an opt-in rewarded mini-game alternative to mandatory account creation.
The user taps Play Now to view the clear reward offer before engaging.
The user plays the 15-second mini-game with Luzia as Game Partner.
Upon REWARD_VERIFIED, temporary favorite message saving is unlocked for 72 hours.
